title: Titan X Banana Ice Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Banana Ice is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This convenient refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, ensuring easy setup and extended flavour without messy refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. Banana Ice delivers the rich, mellow sweetness of ripe Banana with a brisk Menthol finish for a cool, fruity vape. The soft fruit notes are complemented perfectly by the refreshing chill, creating a flavour that’s smooth, uplifting, and balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. With a pre-installed mesh coil for excellent flavour clarity and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works flawlessly with the Titan X’s smart auto-refill technology to provide up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
